openssh.license: BSD-style OpenSSH license AND bundled third-party notices
openssh.provenance: https://api.github.com/repos/PowerShell/Win32-OpenSSH/releases/tags/10.0.0.0p2-Preview; archive SHA-256 and size agree with release API and downloaded bytes
openssh.support_decision: Private disposable phase-4 candidate only. Public phase-5 release blocked pending explicit reviewed acceptance or supplier replacement. GitHub prerelease=false is not production support.
openssh.signature_status: Native Authenticode publisher verification remains required; archive digest is integrity, not authenticity.
openssh.closure_policy: Only ssh and ssh-keygen clients, imported libcrypto.dll and LICENSE/NOTICE. No server, agent, scripts, services, ACL installers, PKCS11 or hardware-key helpers. Audit system DLL imports against Win11 baseline.

curl.license: curl AND bundled third-party notices; Mozilla CA data MPL-2.0
curl.provenance: https://curl.se/windows/ official versioned x64 distribution; archive SHA-256 agrees with upstream page and downloaded bytes. BUILD-MANIFEST and BUILD-HASHES retained. Upstream signature verification remains qualification evidence.
curl.tls_backend: LibreSSL 4.3.3, statically linked (supplier BUILD-MANIFEST; native curl --version must confirm)
curl.trust_policy: Pinned install-relative curl-ca-bundle.crt only. Both routes pass --disable first then --cacert absolute-path and clear CURL_CA_BUNDLE/SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR. No native store, curlrc, CWD, PATH CA discovery, insecure retry or download fallback. verify_ssl=false is explicit caller behavior only.
curl.signature_status: Official detached OpenSSH archive signature VERIFIED locally using ssh-keygen -Y verify against upstream allowed-signers pinned to curl-for-win 9d77e31e. Good file signature for id-curl-for-win-sign ED25519 SHA256:4XoVc6BoX9VqDd7VhM3dNj0DS5hfutXGdbn/FSxPkoo. Trust anchor reviewed from supplier HTTPS repo, not an independent out-of-band identity. Windows code signatures are reproducibly self-signed, not Windows-trusted publisher evidence.
curl.closure_policy: curl.exe statically links third-party libraries; imported API sets/system DLLs require Win11 baseline audit. No unused libcurl DLL, trurl, wcurl, headers or libraries. Ship pinned CA and all supplier dependency notices.

closure_inventory_format: sorted source-relative file records path,size,sha256; json sort_keys=True separators=(',',':')
